text:
sylvie: FYI opened a small docs PR to reconcile region availability copy and to add a "region pin" SDK snippet for Dedicated deployments. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/534. tagging @alejandra @ian for copy/snippet review.
alejandra: I'll validate the legal phrasing for data residency. Can you paste the current paragraph? I want to ensure we say "are stored in-region" only for Dedicated/Private and keep Hosted wording as transient cache only.
ian: I will convert the existing snippets to the new SDK pattern (js/py) and make the region explicit. Do we want to show both query param and header approaches? Some customers prefer x-rw-region.
sylvie: Let's show the explicit "region" JSON field in examples (this is what the runtime prefers). We can add a short note that advanced users can set X-RW-REGION header for routing-only tests.
ian: Draft JS/TS snippet (fetch async-await):
```js
// fetch example - pin request to eu-west-1 (Dedicated)
const resp = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.RW_API_KEY}`,
    'Content-Type': 'application/json'
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'redwood-instruct-1', input: 'Explain ACID in one sentence', region: 'eu-west-1' })
});
const { output } = await resp.json();
console.log(output);
```

ian: Python snippet to match:
```py
# requests - pin to eu-west-1 for Dedicated
import os, requests
resp = requests.post(
  'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate',
  headers={'Authorization': f"Bearer {os.environ['RW_API_KEY']}"},
  json={'model': 'redwood-instruct-1', 'input': 'Explain ACID in one sentence', 'region': 'eu-west-1'}
)
print(resp.json().get('output'))
```
alejandra: Copy edits: replace "may be stored" with "are stored" for Dedicated/Private; add parenthetical "(encrypted at rest, KMS-managed)"; and add the canonical compliance link to /compliance/data-residency/eu. Legal prefers short sentence: "EU residency is supported for Dedicated and Private deployments; contact Sales for on-prem options."
sylvie: Good. I also noticed an old link to /compliance/eu in the docs that the link-checker flagged. @link-bot can you confirm?
link-bot: Link-checker: found 1 broken internal link -> /compliance/eu referenced in docs/region-availability.md. Recommended replacement: /compliance/data-residency/eu.
iany: Updated the PR: replaced the broken link, applied Alejandra's copy edits, and added the JS and Python snippets. Also added a short footnote about header-based routing (X-RW-REGION) for advanced routing tests.
maya: Quick nit: can we make the JS snippet use a consistent model name we use across docs (redwood-instruct-1) and avoid 'gpt' prefixes? Thanks.
sylvie: Done. Pushed a tiny commit. I'll run docs CI and merge if green.

link-bot: CI: passed.
sylvie: Merged. Thanks for the quick turn. We'll follow up if Legal flags anything else. :rocket:
